about: The Audio Decoder's sink end as AudioDecoderModule.buildPipeline builds it, from the queue before its decoder on (the default 300 ms queue); %DECODER% stands for the decoder element, %SINK% for `pulsesink name=sink device=<node>`, %TS_OFFSET% for the ts-offset (ns; it times nothing on a sync=false sink), and its stream-properties are left off. There is no queue between `asrc` and the sink, so the push into the sink is `asrc`'s own chain. AudioDecoderModule.test.ts holds the module's string to it; gst_302m_late_feed_test.py runs it into a real pulsesink (B-249 fix round 2).
